title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Payment Position Attributes by Payer Class
content:
Where a patient holds more than one coverage under **Insurance Coverage & Claims**, each payer class brings fixed attributes to the question of who pays first. The matrix records those attributes for all seven payer classes.

| Payer class | Can be the primary payer | Pays after any other health coverage the patient holds (payer of last resort) | Employer size at or above which a current-employment employer group plan pays before Medicare | Claim reaches this payer automatically from Medicare when it is secondary | Other-coverage denial (CO-22) requires the patient to update other-coverage information with the payer before refiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Yes | No | 20 employees | No | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | Yes | No | 20 employees | No | Yes |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | No | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Yes | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | Yes |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | Yes | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | No | Yes |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | Yes | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | Yes |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | Yes | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | Yes |

## Reading notes

- **Employer size figure.** The figure applies only to the Medicare payer classes that carry it, Original Medicare Part B and Medicare Advantage Plan, both at 20 employees. It is a threshold reached "at or above": an employer of exactly 20 employees meets it, an employer of 19 does not. A figure of 0 means the attribute does not apply to that payer class.
- **Automatic crossover.** Where the column reads "Yes", the claim reaches the payer automatically from Medicare when that payer is secondary, and the laboratory files nothing with it.
- **Never primary.** Medicare Supplement Plan is the only payer class that cannot be the primary payer.
- **Other-coverage denials.** All seven payer classes require the patient to update their other-coverage information with the payer before a claim denied as other coverage primary (CO-22) is refiled.
